preprocess: subtract arithmetic mean, then multiply separable 2-D Hann
transform: full complex fft2; fftshift radial mask; zero other complex coefficients; ifft2; real part
display: coolwarm centred at zero; shared-scale and per-panel auto-scale versions
energy: sum of squared inverse-FFT image; total is sum of squared preprocessed image
normal_selection: among individually clean surrounding 8 blocks, choose band-energy fraction nearest their median
selection: highest prior 0.02-0.05 radial-spectrum RMS among examples with at least one clean reference; fill with no-clean examples only if needed
